html:
G'oya

Rejani savdolar yig'indisi bilan solishtirish kerak, alohida savdo bilan emas. Shuning uchun avval har bir menejerning jami savdosini CTE'da hisoblab olamiz, keyin bu tayyor jadvalni targets bilan ulaymiz va shartni tekshiramiz.

Yechim

WITH totals AS (
  SELECT manager, SUM(amount) AS total_sales
  FROM sales
  GROUP BY manager
)
SELECT t.manager, t.total_sales, g.target
FROM totals t
JOIN targets g ON g.manager = t.manager
WHERE t.total_sales >= g.target

Oddiy JOIN rejasi yo'q menejerni o'zi tashlab yuboradi: namunada Nodiraning savdosi bor, lekin targets da u yo'q, demak juft topilmaydi. Savdosi yo'q Dilshod ham totals da yo'q, u ham chiqmaydi.

Tuzoqlar

Shartda > yozilsa, rejani aynan bajargan menejer yo'qoladi. Namunada Jasurning savdosi 900, rejasi ham 900. Masala "teng yoki katta" deydi.

GROUP BY ni unutib, har bir savdoni alohida solishtirish ham ko'p uchraydi. Azizning savdolari 300 va 500, ularning hech biri 700 ga yetmaydi, lekin jami 800:

Noto'g'riSELECT s.manager, s.amount, g.target
FROM sales s
JOIN targets g ON g.manager = s.manager
WHERE s.amount >= g.target

LEFT JOIN va COALESCE(g.target, 0) bilan rejasizlarni 0 deb olish ham xato: har qanday savdo 0 dan katta, Nodira natijaga kirib qoladi.

Boshqa yo'l

CTE'siz, HAVING bilan ham bo'ladi. Bu holda target ham GROUP BY ga qo'shiladi, aks holda PostgreSQL uni SELECT da ko'rsatishga ruxsat bermaydi:

SELECT s.manager, SUM(s.amount) AS total_sales, g.target
FROM sales s
JOIN targets g ON g.manager = s.manager
GROUP BY s.manager, g.target
HAVING SUM(s.amount) >= g.target
